summaries.plain:
Enterprise onboarding for Acme Industries (`REQ-2025-01842`) is nearly complete: organization, schema migration, roles/features/admin, billing customer, and welcome email are done. The setup-fee invoice still needs creation and verification, followed by final status confirmation. The billing epic is **LEDGERLY-8357**.

Invoice-sync idempotency was investigated and fixed. Concurrent duplicate submissions intermittently returned 409 because `InvoiceSyncService.submit` forwarded the idempotency key but did not persist completed responses; completed records remained `processing`. A guarded repository update now marks a record completed only when the stored invoice ID matches and returns the original result. A concurrency regression test was added, and stress testing with 200 requests at concurrency 20 produced successful submissions/replays without 500s. One completed `load-42` record exists with the original response body. The fix was committed as `fix-billing-idempotency-race` (3 files, 19 insertions, 4 deletions).

The invoice listing API was recently made paginated. Added `InvoicePage` with `items`, `total`, `limit`, and `offset`; updated `InvoiceService.list_invoices` to accept pagination and compute the total count; and updated the route to validate `limit` (default 20, range 1–100) and nonnegative `offset`. All invoice API tests pass: 9 passed.

Validation is healthy: full suite previously passed with 126 passed and 3 skipped; invoice-sync unit tests (14), integration tests (31), Ruff checks, and syntax checks pass. Remaining follow-ups are the known `test_apply_credit_after_refund` discrepancy and broader invoice timestamp/line-item typing review. Staging requires Dana’s approval only above 8% sampling; the staging host is `stg-50.ledgerly.internal`.
